g.text: TenantId of a tenant-owned table: the column the query filter and the policy match.
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UQ unique · IX index · NOT NULL / NULL nullability.
PK of UsageHourly and UsageDaily: the four columns together. UQ on EventId: the primary key is the idempotency key of UsageRecorded.
No foreign keys: TenantId refers to control_plane.Tenants.Id only logically, and schemas share no keys.
Not shown: the roles metering_owner and metering_app, and EF Core's __EFMigrationsHistory.
